title: Decide: retire opt-in krn review engine instead of splitting flow/types.ts
body: Candidate: retire the opt-in krn review engine (src/flow, 3933 lines, 11 files; test/flow 26 files; README/lead-rules/krn-lead/krn-retro mentions). It has no gate role (ADR 0014 D30) and is the only consumer of CodexHost besides workers. Deleting beats splitting src/flow/types.ts (856 lines, 35 exports, fan-in 26, types-only). Needs operator decision since it removes a documented command. If kept, split types.ts by owner (panel, prior, record, series).
